_allowed_clients_help: Only these computers can open the page. Add PC IP addresses or a whole subnet (e.g. 10.20.30.0/24). 127.0.0.1 = this server itself.
_access_key_help: Optional shared password. Leave empty to rely on the IP list only.
_roots_help: The ONLY folders the file browser can open. writable=true lets people save outputs there.
_cors_help: Pages opened from somewhere other than this server. "null" = index.html double-clicked as a file. Add e.g. "https://<you>.github.io" for GitHub Pages.
_upload_help: Files people upload from their own PC are saved here (shown as 'Uploaded files' in the browser).
_dashboards_help: Streamlit dashboards started by this server and shown in the page. autostart = start them all when the server starts.
